latestSuccessfulWorkflowPhases.interpretation: The shared CLI producer remains a build bottleneck. The editor job spends almost all its time waiting for that artifact, and the longest job finishes its audit after that same wait.
limitations: GitHub step timestamps measure complete script phases; the 860-second build phase is not a rustc unit duration.
This run used the hosted fallback. The measured Kache experiment and the deployed persistent Kache store apply to owned runners, so their timings do not describe this producer.
Only one workflow was decomposed into phases. These observations identify a live bottleneck, not a controlled causal comparison.

nativeRuntimePrPhases.interpretation: The hosted CLI producer still exceeds the 600-second target by itself. Its dependents wait for the same artifact; the owned-runner Kache trial does not describe this hosted target-archive path.
limitations: This is a pull-request run, not a successful merge-group latency sample.
No physical core, LLM, or orchestration extraction was present in this head.
Source changes, cache contents and runner load differ from previous runs; these phases are observations, not a controlled speedup.
The macOS workspace job failed because required sandbox mechanisms were unavailable, and review approval remained pending. This head was not integrated when recorded.

workflowMethod.selection: Latest five completed successful ci.yml merge_group runs at each checkpoint, in API recency order.
workflowMethod.elapsed: GitHub workflow updatedAt minus startedAt after terminal success, excluding queue admission wait.
workflowMethod.quantile: Nearest-rank p90; with five observations this is the maximum.
limitations: Five successful runs are a progress sample, not a stable estimate of end-to-end pull-request latency or failure recovery.
Caches, host load, unrelated merged changes, and the mix of changed crates were not controlled. The difference cannot be attributed exclusively to this issue.
The provider catalog and native runtime changes were still open when these workflows ran.
